metadata.description: Validation test for heading without a magnetometer (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T19): the vehicle faces 60° with its estimate at 0°. Flying forward, the estimate snaps to the GPS course at 1 m/s and converges on it (heading within 2° of the track, the true yaw within 8° allowing for sideslip), and GPS heading becomes established. Position Hold (pos_hold_without_mag on) is refused before that and holds after.
